title: Lentil and vegetable soup with bread
summary: A big pot for the week; freezes well.
steps: Chop the onion and carrot into small pieces. Drain and rinse the lentils if they are tinned.
Heat the oil in a pot over medium heat and soften the onion and carrot for 5 to 7 minutes.
Add the lentils, tomatoes, a pinch each of cumin and paprika, and enough stock or water to cover everything by a finger's width.
Simmer gently for 20 minutes, until the carrot is soft. Blend half of it if you like it thicker, and season with salt and pepper.
